## About
Diamond Automotive is a collision and auto body shop on SW 58th Ave in West Park. We know an accident can be emotional and stressful, so we focus on personal care for every customer and every car that comes through our doors.
Each repair follows the same process. We sort out what work is needed and schedule it, keep you updated as your car moves through each stage, and when the final parts go back on we check the functions and clean the interior and exterior before you pick it up.
Our team of repair process managers, parts and claims staff works together on every job. Neighbors have rated us 4.8 from 1405 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Body work after a collision. A reviewer had their rear-view mirror, back door and front fender repaired here.
- Wheel alignments: Alignment work, including after impacts that throw your car off.
- Diagnosis: We look into what is going on with your car and explain it before work starts.
- Photo estimates: Ask us about getting an estimate from photos of the damage.
- Auto glass repair: Glass repair as part of our collision services.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all major insurance carriers. We guide you through the claims process, including your rental car and paperwork, and make sure the required procedures are completed correctly.

Q: How will I know how the repair is going?
A: We update you as your car moves through the repair stages, by text, phone or email, whichever works for you.

Q: Is the repair covered by a warranty?
A: Our repairs come with a lifetime warranty. Give us a call and we can walk you through the details.
